title: Sherpa-UI Custom Node type
description: A type of Custom Node, as JSON (plan 942 D2 A): its name, icon and category in the Nodes panel, the sockets every node of it has, and the families its sub-graph may place. Each node of it is an entity (entity.v2) whose graph is what it does. An entities file names it under `types`, by id.

category.description: Where its nodes stand in the Nodes panel, as Runbooks. None: Custom Nodes.

families.description: The families (a kind's category) its sub-graph may place; none, any.

runs.description: It needs the runner to be of use; none, false: only defined.

reusable.description: Its nodes are Custom Nodes a graph may place; none, true. False (a Coworker): the Nodes panel leaves them out, and an Output Trigger starts one (plan 949).
